changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Additional office assignments for a user, for multi-location access

changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Permission granting descent from an assigned office into its child offices
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_permission (`grouping`, code, entity_name, action_name, can_maker_checker) VALUES ('authorisation', 'HIERARCHICAL_OFFICEACCESS', 'OFFICEACCESS', 'HIERARCHICAL', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `grouping` = 'authorisation'

changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Strict office scoping, disabled so that existing users keep their current visibility
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO c_configuration (name, value, enabled, is_trap_door, description) VALUES ('strict-office-scope', NULL, 0, 0, 'When enabled, a user sees only the offices they are assigned to, with no child offices unless they hold HIERARCHICAL_OFFICEACCESS. When disabled, every user keeps the platform default of seeing their own office and every office beneath it.') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description)

changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Permission granting access to the offices additionally assigned to a user
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_permission (`grouping`, code, entity_name, action_name, can_maker_checker) VALUES ('authorisation', 'MULTILOCATION_OFFICEACCESS', 'OFFICEACCESS', 'MULTILOCATION', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `grouping` = 'authorisation'

changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Roles already granted the single office access permission keep both halves of it
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT rp.role_id, multi.id FROM m_role_permission rp JOIN m_permission single ON single.id = rp.permission_id AND single.code = 'HIERARCHICAL_OFFICEACCESS' JOIN m_permission multi ON multi.code = 'MULTILOCATION_OFFICEACCESS' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission existing WHERE existing.role_id = rp.role_id AND existing.permission_id = multi.id )
